lighthouse_detail: full - complete audits array captured per URL via direct DataForSEO REST (on_page/lighthouse/live/json, for_mobile=false). lighthouse_issues[] holds the top 5 per URL. lighthouse_failing_ids[] holds every audit with score < 1.
environment_caveats: live_origin_source=apex. apex_cutover.completed_at is 2026-09-08T17:52:50Z, so https://callcrs.com was audited. curl -sI shows no x-robots-tag on the apex, and SEO counts toward the verdict this run. The prior run (2026-08-26) audited the staging Pages preview with SEO excluded, so the SEO delta (+31) is mostly the noindex artifact clearing, not a code change.
URL matching for regression uses url_path because the origin changed from staging.rankai-coastal-restoration-services.pages.dev to callcrs.com.
Lighthouse ran DESKTOP (configSettings.formFactor=desktop). Mobile scores would typically run 10-20 performance points lower. No mobile-first claim is made.

https://www.callcrs.com/ returns HTTP 200 and serves the site directly. It does not 301 to the apex. rel=canonical on www pages points at https://callcrs.com/..., so the duplicate host is mitigated but not eliminated.

DataForSEO has_micromarkup reported false again despite 3-5 JSON-LD blocks on every page (verified by fetching the served HTML). Schema checks in this run were performed by parsing the served HTML directly.

Root cause of rankai_wrong_primary_city_in_metadata, verified in scripts/build_site.py:964-981: the RENDERED-CONTENT GUARD keeps any content file whose frontmatter has rendered: true. The 2026-09-23 url-plan regeneration corrected titles/H1s/meta to Santa Maria, but already-rendered pages kept their old Vandenberg Village frontmatter. They need a targeted render --url ... --force.
